**HELD for Matt** (Order HC1 §5, R12: the session found two routes deliberately published on both domains, so nothing served is self-merged without Matt confirming the estate map). Every check should be green; merge is Matt's call.

## Measurement that motivated it
Static link resolver over the rebuilt `education-lessons` publication tree (site builder `ff764b65`, Lessons `904a3c1`): in all twelve `LAUNCH_ASDAN/Autumn1_W1-W7_2026-27/LAUNCH_ASDAN_W*.html` decks the control `⌂ Start Here` is `href="../../START_HERE.html"`, which resolves to `/Lessons/START_HERE.html` — a 404 on the served site. Confirmed in headless Chromium against a local Pages-style mount. Cause: the LAUNCH donor chassis (`tools/donors/ART_DONOR_v1/LAUNCH_chassis.html`) is written for packs two directories deeper (`W7-W12_2026-27/lessons/<unit>/`, where the same href is correct); this pack is one level up. These are the decks taught in Autumn 1 weeks 1–7.

## Change
One defect class, twelve decks: `href="../../START_HERE.html"` → `href="START_HERE.html"` (the hub beside the decks). `SHA256SUMS.txt` refreshed with `tools/easter/refresh_pack_checksums.py` (existing rows only, 14→14, verify OK). No other bytes change.

## Firing control (Appendix B) for the gate
Run 1 real tree: this class red (12). Run 2 scratch copy with one planted dead link: red +1, named. Run 3 planted link removed: back to baseline. VALID.

## Proof before push (R5)
Each of the twelve, served at `/Lessons/`: zero page errors, prints (3 A4 pages), advances `#slide-1 → #slide-2` on Next, Start Here answers 200. `refresh_pack_checksums.py --check` PASS; `g29_plan_binding.py --scope authored` 101 PASS / 0 RED on main baseline (unchanged files).

## Rollback
Lessons `main` `904a3c1a6d065438b763048cc9f51221c2e636ad`; revert commit `d88d436ec62b1f3ccc241a18a823c429ff6e2f43`.

## Served-proof plan
After merge: Education Pages publication run for the merge SHA → `fieldops-p2-and-sweep.yml` *Merged is not served* byte-identity, then dispatch nothing extra; the twelve routes are inside the published tree the job compares.

Route ownership: none of these files is touched by an open PR (touch sets measured 2026-09-06).
